successors.name: Spanish Empire
successors.text: The Tz'utujil 'in the southern watershed of Lake Atitlán' around Chuitinamit near Santiago Atitlán; the pages give no extent

ledger.x: Post-classic: 'The Tz'utujil date from the post-classic period (circa 900-1500)'; the page gives no founding year, so 900 is a bridge.
18 April 1524: Alvarado fights the Tz'utujil at the lakeshore ('This battle took place on 18 April'); the Tz'utujil page dates the defeat '1523, with the help of the Kaqchikel'.
April 1524: 'The next day the Spanish found Tecpán Atitlán deserted, and the Tz'utujil later submitted'; no date for the submission.
April 1524: the Tz'utujil lakeshore falls to the Spanish and their Kaqchikel allies.
April 1524: the Tz'utujil kingdom ends with the defeat at Atitlán.

wars.name: Spanish and Kaqchikel conquest of the Tz'utujil
wars.outcome: 18 April 1524: battle at the lakeshore; the Spanish enter deserted Tecpán Atitlán the next day.

wars.name: K'iche'-Kaqchikel and Tz'utujil wars
wars.outcome: 'After the death of king K'iq'ab in 1475 the K'iche' were engaged in warfare', fighting the Tz'utujil and the Kaqchikel; no outcome for the Tz'utujil is stated.
